name: omnilab/mpc
description: Omnilab MPC: a minor planet, comet or natural satellite of the IAU's Minor Planet Center by its number, designation (provisional, packed or not) or name - its designations, name and naming citation, its orbit as the MPC computes it (osculating elements with their uncertainties, perihelion, period, MOIDs), absolute magnitude, observations, oppositions, arc and uncertainty parameter; a search of the names; its latest observations - through the MPC's APIs, no key needed.
